summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the `EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum)` class with all eleven members, values, and comments. (2) botocore/args.py: added the `EPRBuiltins` import after the botocore.endpoint import; made `_should_set_global_sts_endpoint` accept `endpoint_config=None` (treated as no variant tags); added `compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults` at the end of ClientArgsCreator, reusing the bridge's FIPS variant lookup, DualStack lookup, and the existing S3/STS predicates. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (25 tests covering every behavioral criterion). Results: tests/unit/test_args.py passes (59 tests). The full unit suite has 11 failures (test_awsrequest.py, test_session.py, test_session_legacy.py), and the same 11 fail on the original code, so they predate this change. black/isort/flake8 are not installed in the shared venv and were not run; line length was checked with awk (no added line over 79 columns), and import order was checked by hand. Nothing is committed.
